title: A device that turns reminders on settles its own row after a later erase
evidence: Built to the owner's option A (2026-11-25), with the review rulings R1-R6 folded in. The page that writes a reminders token keeps one entry per token, { token, lineage, erase }, in one localStorage key (hr_reminders_own_enrolment), at most 8; each entry is one state, OwnEntry (kept | cancelling), and the list changes only by the pure ownEnrolmentTransition (widget-src/standalone/reminders-own-enrolment.ts), following the record's owed-clear pattern (clearOwed / settleClear, packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts). lineage is the store the record was read from (cleared-erase.ts's identity; storage.ts cloudRecordHere): an entry settles only against that store's record, and log-off and a cloud switch remove the key (standalone/connect.ts). It settles at the load's first read from the cloud and on every hr:remote-changed, never on a fallback or before the read. A record of the same lineage at a later erase that does not hold the token active gets one keepalive cancel; an entry leaves only when its own cancel answers 2xx (the tab that sent it holds the row in memory, so a refused claim write does not keep it). This device's Turn off and each of its own erase commit's cancels remove an entry only when that cancel answers ok. Rule (owner ruling R2, option a): the record is the source of truth for the opt-in; a row whose token has no active opt-in after a later erase is cancelled even when another device meanwhile refreshed the same row by address without a token. Own lead: an address-lane refresh leaves the record's opt-in off. Tests: widget-src/standalone/reminders-own-enrolment.test.ts (44: behaviour tests over the real store and an in-memory cloud, the R1, R3, R4, R5 and R6 tests failing first on the previous build, the R2 and enrolment-write-refused tests pinning behaviour as it stands, and the transition table). US-11 AC4 and AC4c amended. Limit: a refused enrolment write keeps nothing. Residual: a device that enrolled and never opens the page again keeps its row until the email unsubscribe link is used.
